title: dalea polystachya
intro: Dalea polystachya, commonly known as the summer cassia or butterfly pea, is a perennial legume native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Dalea polystachya may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant has also been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
